what: Digests of every kit 31203 output: the 8 bundled recipes x combinations A, B, C built from the dataset fixtures (tests/fixtures/datasets) through the CLI commands (research R9, SC-001). Compared by tests/integration/test_kit_outputs_unchanged.py. First written from an unmodified checkout of main at commit 6038d9c, without any feature 016 production change (re-based once, on 2026-11-23, from af3ce57: only the 24 preview.png digests changed). Rewritten on main by the merge of feature 010 (Pacific-centred arrangements D and E, main 6f300dc): every sheet set gains an assembly page and the ENSO recipes' checksums changed. Regenerated by feature 017 (map stickers) on each merge of main into it: on 2026-11-24 (feature 016) and on 2026-11-25 (main 6f300dc, feature 010): 017 appends the sticker tables the project owner approved on 2026-11-24 to the eight bundled recipes, which changes every recorded recipe SHA-256 and the checksums derived from it (layout, report, cells, parts lists, estimate, section counts, map build and map cells text, sheets SVG and PDF: 248 digests); no other output changed (see regenerated).
generator: PYTHONPATH=tools .venv/bin/python -m maptemplates kit-golden --fixtures --out tests/fixtures/golden/kit_outputs.json (run from cli/)

code.note: the kit outputs of main 6f300dc's library code (features 016 and 010 merged): the merged tree reproduces main 6f300dc's committed file byte for byte on main's recipe bytes (regenerated.proof), so the file holds 6f300dc's kit outputs with feature 017's recipe checksums

previous.note: main's file, written by the merge of feature 010 (main's kit_outputs.source.json was not updated then and still named 6038d9c and 8a865bb3...)

regenerated.by: feature 017, on the merge of main 6f300dc into 017-map-stickers that the project owner approved on 2026-11-25 (task T054's proof procedure; research R13)
regenerated.reason: feature 017's approved sticker tables (a '# Map stickers (feature 017):' line and a [sticker] table appended to each bundled recipe) change the recipe SHA-256 recorded in every output
regenerated.proof: before rewriting, the same harness ran on the merged tree with the eight bundled recipes replaced by their bytes before the sticker block (cli/tests/integration/stickers_guard.py prefix_bytes; SHA-256 equal to main 6f300dc's, guard G1): its document equalled main 6f300dc's committed file byte for byte; feature 017's guards G1-G4 (re-based on main 6f300dc, A-E) passed
regenerated.supersedes: 016's rule that this file is only written from an unmodified checkout of main; T054's proof procedure replaces it for this regeneration
